svg.text: Stage 1 wiring: ESP32 to both radar sensors
Boards drawn component side up, as in your photos. Coloured pins get a wire; dark pins stay empty. Unplug USB before wiring.
Use the COM / UART port (normally the left one; the label is on the back).
Check: Windows Device Manager shows "USB-SERIAL CH343".
Pin positions counted from the TOP of each header.
Sensor WU pin (you soldered one): leave it empty.
Any other sensor pin not listed: leave empty.
The sensors' own USB-C ports: only for reflashing,
never plugged in while wired to the ESP32.
Sensor 3V3 must come from ESP32 3V3, never 5 V.
W9 and W10 are dashed purple: reset lines, required. Solder one header pin into each sensor's RST hole (left header, bottom pin) first.
